question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Created [src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g3_checkout_request/okf/codex/4/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) and verified it loads and returns the right shape with node. It maps the inputs to the backend's order request field names: `quoteId` (chosen shipping option), `currency`, `termsAccepted`, `orderNote`, and `payment` with `paymentType: "CREDITCARD"`, `transactionType: "CAPTURE"`, `processor` (payment module), `cardToken` (payment token), and `amount` — note the backend names `processor`/`cardToken` differ from the `paymentModule`/`paymentToken` names Checkout.js sends.
